title: DoorSizeDefault
description: Contract for Brain Migration Slice 1 — door-size defaults by access type (Stage 1 roller-door sub-screen). Contract version 1.0.0. Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain. Any copy elsewhere (e.g. vendored into the application repository) is a mechanically identical mirror, never independently edited.

DoorAccessTypeInput.description: The raw access-type value selected by the customer in the roller-door access dropdown. Only 'HGV', 'Van' and 'Forklift' are recognised and produce a default; any other string (including empty, null, undefined, or an unrecognised/legacy value) is valid input and must produce a null output — comparison is case-sensitive exact string match.

DoorSizeDefaultOutput.description: The suggested preliminary door size for a recognised access type, in metres, or null when no default applies (the customer enters the exact size themselves).

width.description: Door width in metres. Always 4.6 for every currently recognised access type.

height.description: Door height in metres. 5.0 for HGV; 4.0 for Van/Forklift.
